name: Kaitlin Black
source: Bad grades, bad crowd, if it's trouble or a bad name then Katy's the girl you wanna see. Since she has no powers Katy's always trying to act tough to keep the bullies away, but that doesn't stop the bullies in her head. Tough on the outside, insecure on the inside. Katy might have street respect especially since she tags and plays with the cops so well but she can't seem to have some from herself. She took her own life due to her thoughts and was pleasantly surprised to know she actually gain powers from it, even if she has to share her life and body with another person. Maybe now she can gain more than just street cred from her friends, or maybe even from her brother who doesn't even acknowledge their related.
